title: BioMate nf-core/differentialabundance (embedded DESeq2 stub)
description: Parameters for BioMate's standalone DESeq2 differential expression workflow. Accepts the same interface as nf-core/differentialabundance but executes embedded R code in a single Batch task.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Sample metadata CSV with a 'sample' column and condition columns. Required.

matrix.description: Count matrix CSV (genes × samples). Row names = gene IDs; column names = sample IDs matching 'input'. Required.

contrasts.description: Contrasts CSV with columns id, variable, reference, target. Optional; auto-derived from metadata if absent.

differential_min_fold_change.description: Minimum absolute fold-change for a gene to be called significant (used in volcano plot and gene list output).

differential_max_qval.description: Maximum adjusted p-value (BH-FDR) cutoff for significant genes.

study_type.description: Assay type — controls how counts are pre-processed before DE analysis.
